result.summary: No critical visual breakage detected. The layout, banners and restaurant cards render correctly; only minor cosmetic inconsistencies observed with the top-right profile placeholder and wishlist icon styling.

issues.description: Top-right circular element appears as an empty light-grey circle with a small red dot and no icon or avatar inside
issues.suggestion: Ensure profile/notification button loads its icon or avatar image, or replace empty circle with a clear icon

issues.description: Wishlist heart icon styling is inconsistent between Popular cards: Tokumaru Ramen Bar heart has no background, pizza card heart has dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Use consistent wishlist button style with same circular background and contrast on all cards
